ranged_attack.name: Burst Fire
ranged_attack.windup: plants his feet, shoulders his assault rifle with both hands and aims down the sights at {target}, his cheek pressed to the stock
ranged_attack.release: squeezes the trigger and the rifle kicks against his shoulder in bright yellow-white muzzle flashes
ranged_attack.travel: three glowing orange tracer rounds streak across the yard as thin bright lines of light
ranged_attack.impact: the tracers punch into {target} in three sharp orange sparks and puffs of dust and torn padding
ranged_attack.decay: the sparks and dust clear in a split second, leaving {target} in plain view
ranged_attack.again: fires another burst of glowing orange tracers that spark against {target} and clear at once
ranged_attack.text: shoulders his assault rifle at {target} and fires a short burst with bright muzzle flashes, glowing orange tracers sparking on it in puffs of dust that clear at once

melee_attack.name: Rifle Butt
melee_attack.windup: steps in and draws his rifle back with both hands, twisting his shoulders to load the blow
melee_attack.impact: the rifle stock slams into {target} with a heavy thud and a burst of bright orange sparks and dust
melee_attack.decay: the sparks wink out at once
melee_attack.recover: brings the rifle back across his chest
melee_attack.again: slams the rifle stock into {target} again in a burst of bright orange sparks that wink out at once
melee_attack.text: draws his rifle back and drives the stock into {target} with a heavy thud and a burst of bright orange sparks that wink out at once

dash.name: Combat Sprint
dash.text: breaks into a low combat sprint, boots kicking up dust and small glowing sparks from the concrete
